title: After the research story lands, the orchestrator reruns precheck so a sibling check the research already satisfies is tightened before its claim
goal: The kb-sprint run step reruns backlog.py precheck SP after the goal research story lands and tightens each sibling check that now passes before its claim; planning words a goal clause no stronger than its check (SP-5x5ut5ko: ST-24m3pttf's flags.go fact made ST-owuunsvl's first check pass before its work while ST-tjaxw22f's check required Resolved though its goal said resolved or narrowed); done accepts an item whose checks pass when a KB-Work commit of the sprint's goal research story changed a file in its touches, records that commit as its evidence and close credits its goal clause to the item (SP-tjap3mdd: ST-74agak3p wrote the whole fix of BG-a22yrzap and BG-skpnth6v so both were dropped as no-work-commit and close --summary printed their clauses as unmet)
